q: Tell me about yourself.
Why do you want this role, and why here?
Walk me through a project you are most proud of.
Tell me about a time you took ownership of a problem nobody else was handling.
Describe a time you went beyond what your role required.
Tell me about a time you led a team or a project without formal authority.
Describe a time you helped a struggling teammate improve.
Tell me about a disagreement with a colleague and how you resolved it.
Describe a time you received critical feedback. What did you do with it?
Tell me about a time you pushed back on a manager or stakeholder.
Tell me about a time you failed. What did you learn?
Describe a mistake you made and how you fixed it.
Tell me about a project that did not go as planned.
Describe a time you had to act without clear requirements or full information.
Tell me about a time priorities changed suddenly. How did you adapt?
Tell me about a time you persuaded someone to change their mind.
Describe how you got buy-in for an idea from people who were skeptical.
Tell me about working with a cross-functional team toward a shared goal.
Tell me about a time you went out of your way for a customer or user.
Describe a time you dealt with a difficult customer or client.
Tell me about a decision you made using data. What was the result?
Describe a time the data contradicted your intuition.
How do you measure whether your work succeeded? Give an example.
Tell me about a time you worked with a difficult teammate.
Describe your role in the most effective team you have worked on.
Tell me about a time you had to meet a tight deadline.
Describe how you prioritise when everything seems urgent.
Tell me about a time you had to juggle several projects at once.
Where do you see yourself in a few years?
What questions do you have for us?
